name: Cloth×Close ~Boku ga Queen!?~
original_name: Cloth×Close（クロース×クロース）～ボクがくぃ～ん!?～
source:
There is a strange but traditional event at this boys high school. That is "Miss Contest". Students wear girl's clothes and compete for their beauty, even though this is a boys high school. All the students don't want to do it but this is a tradition lasting for a long period. The season of "Dressing Girl's Clothes" comes again...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090107140927/http://web.archive.org/web/20090107140927/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1004593]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
这所男校有一个奇特但传统的活动——“选美大赛”。学生们穿上女装比拼美貌——尽管这是一所男校。所有学生都不情愿，但这是延续已久的传统。“穿女装”的季节又来了……
